# agent-layers schemas

Byte-for-byte copies of `access-question.json` and `common.json` from the agent-layers repository, directory
`spec/schemas/`, last changed at commit `ceab97031af6fb44ee585d36616bfc05a5cd643d`.

`test/access-question-schema.test.ts` validates reinloop's `AccessQuestion` output against them. Re-copy both files
(and update the commit hash here) whenever the SDK schema changes.
